title: Dots & Boxes
blurb: Draw lines, close squares, get double-crossed. Play against Amog himself, who has read Berlekamp and will not hesitate.

title: The Thesis
blurb: Amog proves $\chi = \chi_\ell = \operatorname{Col}$ after a suitable choice of notation. The proofs are constructive except where compactness makes a construction unnecessary.
